title: CodeLine
responsibility: Shows complete source text with explicit clipping or wrapping and an optional caller-owned inspection control.

inputs.name: CodeLine.text
inputs.description: Complete source text rendered as code content and assigned unchanged to its native title. It applies in both modes; clipping affects only the visible presentation, and the component imposes no text-length limit.

inputs.name: CodeLine.mode
inputs.description: Selects the code presentation and defaults to 'clip'. Clip uses one ellipsized line; wrap preserves whitespace and breaks long tokens anywhere.

inputs.name: CodeLine.action
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered after the code in an adjacent action span when supplied. It is undefined when omitted; the caller owns its behavior and focus return.

inputs.name: CodeLine.className
inputs.description: Optional string appended to the wrapper's code-line class and defaults to an empty string. The component uses it as a class value and does not use it to select the code's wrapping mode.

outputs.name: CodeLine
outputs.description: Renders text in an hx-code element inside an inline-flex wrapper, with the full string in the element's title; mode selects nowrap and ellipsis or preserved whitespace wrapping. When action is supplied, the snippet appears in an adjacent non-shrinking span, and its behavior remains caller-owned.
